features: SMART RING COVER FOR DAILY PROTECTION: This Smart Ring Cover and Ring Protector is designed to help protect smart rings from daily scratches and surface contact. Compatible with Oura Ring, Samsung Galaxy Ring, Gabit Ring and other smart ring models for work, sports and everyday activities.

SOFT SILICONE DESIGN WITH COMFORTABLE FIT: Made from flexible silicone material, this Ring Cover for Smart Rings provides a lightweight and comfortable wearing experience. The elastic design allows easy installation and removal while maintaining normal smart ring usage.

DURABLE SILICONE STRUCTURE WITH MULTI COLOR STYLE: Made with soft silicone material, these ring covers feature a flexible structure suitable for daily use. The 5PCS set includes black, white, transparent, rose red and purple colors for different style preferences.

SUITABLE FOR WORK & ACTIVE LIFESTYLE: Designed for different situations including outdoor activities, workouts, swimming, office use and daily routines. The lightweight silicone cover adds a stylish appearance while helping keep your smart ring protected during activities.

PACKAGE CONTENT & USAGE DETAILS: Includes 5 silicone smart ring covers in different colors. Size: Diameter 2cm, Width 1cm. Select a suitable cover color and gently place it over your smart ring before use.
